title: Actual six-role runtime smoke (not scientific opportunity validation)
scope: Two initial public search results, expanding to ten papers during adversarial retrieval. This is separate from the approximately twenty-paper full-paper pilot.
expected: Public retrieval, separate role execution, structured durable outputs, real trace and cost receipts, no GPU execution.
observed: Seven tasks completed: search, cartographer, failure investigator, generator, novelty investigator with additional retrieval, reviewer, experiment architect. Two tensions and one unverified opportunity persisted across copying the database and reopening the application store.
status: pass for execution; scientific output not accepted
failures: Independent inspection of the live library found eight unrelated astronomy/physics records admitted by the original broad arXiv fallback query. This was a real topical-relevance failure, not successful literature discovery. These records are quarantined in this explicitly failed-scientific-validation smoke campaign, not the 21-paper evidence pilot.

The generated experiment proposed a geographic-neighbor warm-up on University-1652 without verifying geographic metadata availability. The independent full-paper audit of Sample4Geo Section 3.3 explicitly states this initialization was not possible for that benchmark. The smoke experiment is therefore not accepted as a feasible validated plan.
The novelty response was uncertain, and its own summary failed to use all newly retrieved competitors. A separate process plus fresh retrieval does not ensure comprehensive comparison.
Automated adapter inputs are abstracts and bounded source excerpts, not an assurance of full-paper comprehension.
remediation: arXiv queries now conjoin individually quoted non-stopword terms rather than passing unstructured sentences.

A deterministic topical keyword screen rejects unrelated provider results and records exclusions before accepting any paper. An ATLAS-versus-cross-view localization regression fails on the original behavior and passes after the fix.
Automatically retrieved records are now task-unclassified, rather than inheriting the requested domain as if their relevance were established.
An actual browser-triggered campaign on the fixed service is a separate acceptance artifact. Lexical screening alone is not expert relevance validation.
interpretation: Execution success is not research-quality success. These concrete failures must constrain the overall verdict and remain visible; no automatic upgrade to promising was made.
